song.author: Twila Paris
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G C D C G Come and join the reapers, All the kingdom seekers; .G C G D Laying down your life to find it in the end.
[V2] .G C D C G Come and share the harvest, Help to light the darkness, .G C G D G For the Lord is calling faithful men.
song.title: Faithful Men
